source.scope: Herodian Temple Mount and immediate surrounding terrain, circa AD 30

role: reference geometry/evidence adapter; never replaces Jerusalem 3000 terrain authority
absorb: historical dimensions and citations as candidate evidence records
relative historical terrain relationships: Kidron, Tyropoeon, western hill, Mount of Olives
reject: treating reconstruction geometry as survey data
using its terrain as the canonical DEM
promoting hypothetical city buildings into observed/reconstructed authority
forcing its local coordinate frame onto Jerusalem 3000
gates: Every imported object must receive a Jerusalem 3000 stable ID.
Every geometry claim must retain source/variant provenance.
Coordinates must be registered into Jerusalem 3000 local ENU; no independent world frame.
Objects outside the project's stated evidence confidence remain hypothetical/inferred.
Automated checks must validate geometric relationships independently of rendering.
